create_dataset: create a dataset of random bulk structures or molecules with train and validation splits
generate_random_bulk_structure: generate a random bulk crystal structure with displacements and strain for testing
generate_random_molecule: generate a random molecule with specified elements and atom count for unit testing
test_create_finetune_dataset: test the dataset creation pipeline by generating structures and running the UMA finetune dataset script
test_e2e_finetuning_bulks: test end-to-end finetuning by creating a dataset, training a model, and running inference on bulk or molecule structures
